Game Overview

In Go to Dot, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a vibrant arcade world in Go to Dot, dodging relentless red enemies as you chase a massive, pulsing target. Every click determines your path, demanding precision and timing. Discover movement patterns, bide your time, and perfect your strategy to master this addictive, high-stakes pursuit.
